Hi Jenna — thanks for the checklist and call follow-up. I've looped in Marissa (legal ops) and Karthik (integrations) so we can triage. Quick summary from our side:

1) PO acknowledgement SLA: Our standard Order Form includes a PO acknowledgement clause of 5 business days. We can accept a 3-business-day ack as an exception for ProcurePlus but need that recorded on the order form and route for approval (Marissa, please confirm).

2) PO header mapping: Karthik, can you confirm whether Coupa allows a custom remit/location code field that maps to vendor_metadata.remit_location? If not, we will need a short mapping doc to avoid finance mismatches.

3) Evidence: we can receive W9 and SOC2 summary; SOC2 full report requires an NDA in some accounts but the summary is fine for onboarding.

I've uploaded a marked-up MSA with the changes we can accept and a few optional exceptions (see attached Redline_MSA_ProcurePlus_v2.pdf). Marissa — can you review the attached and call out any remaining legal approvals needed (insurance, signatory limits, indemnity carve-outs)?

Action items:
- Marissa: legal review + approval list (by EOD)
- Karthik: Coupa header mapping confirmation (by EOD)
- Jenna: confirm whether ProcurePlus legal can sign via DocuSign and provide signer name/authority.

Thanks,
Aisha
